title: Nissan Rogue / Pathfinder / Altima CVT: judder reflash and 84k-mile warranty extension
summary: Nissan bulletin NTB15-083A adds judder codes P17F0/P17F1 and a TCM reflash for 2013-2015 Altima (QR25) and 2014-2016 Rogue. A June 2022 campaign bulletin extends CVT coverage on 2014-2018 Rogue, 2015 Rogue Select and 2015-2018 Pathfinder to 84 months / 84,000 miles.

specs.name: Judder DTCs added
specs.value: P17F0 CVT_JUDDER (T/M INSPECTION), P17F1 CVT_JUDDER (C/U INSPECTION)

specs.name: Reflash applies to
specs.value: 2013-2015 Altima (L33, QR25 only) and 2014-2016 Rogue (T32), 4-cylinder CVT, when the current TCM part number is listed in the bulletin's Table A

specs.name: Battery voltage during reflash
specs.value: Keep between 12.0 V and 15.5 V (battery maintainer in reflash mode)

specs.name: CVT warranty extension
specs.value: From 60 months / 60,000 miles to 84 months / 84,000 miles, whichever comes first

specs.name: Extension covers
specs.value: CVT assembly and internal parts, gaskets and seals, control valve body, torque converter, cooler kit (if applicable), TCM reprogramming

specs.name: Extension vehicles
specs.value: 2014-2018 Rogue (T32), 2015 Rogue Select (S35), 2015-2018 Pathfinder (R52); not hybrids

specs.name: Replacement parts warranty after a CVT repair
specs.value: 12 months / 12,000 miles from replacement, if longer than what remains of the extension

steps.text: Customer reports a judder: shake, shudder, one or more bumps, or vibration from the transmission.
With CONSULT-III plus, read the current TCM part number (31036-xxxxx) and compare it with Table A in NTB15-083A. Only reflash if it matches; otherwise the bulletin doesn't apply.
Before reflashing: battery maintainer connected and holding 12.0-15.5 V, all electrical loads off, nearby Bluetooth devices off, CONSULT PC on its AC adapter.
Reprogram the TCM, then erase all DTCs; the final confirmation report needs the DTC erase.
For coverage: check the VIN for the CVT extension. Some owners opted out of the class settlement, so coverage is per-VIN, not per-model.
Valve body and CVT belt-and-pulley kits don't need pre-approval under the extension; full CVT replacements over the dealer's authorization limit do.

body:
The warranty extension came out of a class action settlement that the court gave final approval on March 23, 2022 (Nissan owner notification, NHTSA ID 10211969).

The Rogue's model-name match excludes Rogue Sport and Rogue Hybrid, which the extension does not list. The judder reflash and the extension cover different year ranges; check each one against the vehicle.
